title: E-SPN-0183: the light register pair under a weak Coulomb pull: at $a_B$ 12 its main line moves within 17% of its...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0183 in the spin arena: the light register pair under a weak Coulomb pull: at $a_B$ 12 its main line moves within 17% of its energy, but the level is a multiplet and R is no law yet, fail (H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, P): the cycle reduced by the cubic group exactly (witnessed against E-SPN-0173 to 1e-15, its R 8.459326 reproduced), and R read line by line by harmonic inversion, since the filtered level holds several register-channel lines the filter cannot separate; the main line reads R 8.50 at $a_B$ 3.5, is not quadratic in K at $a_B$ 6 (it mixes with lines of other cubic representations), 10.39 at 8, and 1.2693 at 12 against the formula 1.0857 (with the Darwin exchange 1.2495 against tan m / m 1.0656); at $a_B$ 8 the line carrying the bound level (23 times the start overlap) reads 1.534; every point holds, $a_B$ 20 needs about 90 hours and was not run.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
